name: CSF Analysis
ssx: Severe headache, nausea, vomiting, photophobia, neck stiffness, fever, confusion, seizures
preparation: No special preparation. Performed via lumbar puncture by physician.
procedure: Collect cerebrospinal fluid through lumbar puncture. Send immediately to the laboratory for analysis (cell counts, glucose, protein, cultures).

name: FLUID ANALYSIS
ssx: Swelling in joints, pleural effusion, ascites, pericardial effusion
preparation: No special preparation. Fluid is aspirated by physician depending on site (pleural, peritoneal, synovial).
procedure: Collect body fluid (pleural, ascitic, pericardial, synovial). Perform cell counts, chemical analysis, and microscopic evaluation.

name: SEMINAL FLUID ANALYSIS
ssx: Male infertility, abnormal sperm count, erectile dysfunction, difficulty conceiving
preparation: Abstinence from sexual activity for 3–5 days before collection.
procedure: Collect semen sample via masturbation into sterile container. Evaluate sperm count, motility, morphology, and other parameters.

name: CULTURE AND SENSITIVITY - BLOOD
ssx: Fever, chills, sepsis, unexplained infections, prolonged fever of unknown origin
preparation: No fasting required. Specimen collected aseptically prior to antibiotic therapy.
procedure: Collect blood aseptically and inoculate into blood culture bottles. Incubate and monitor for microbial growth. Perform sensitivity testing.

name: ACID FAST BACILLI STAIN
ssx: Cough lasting ≥3 weeks, hemoptysis, chest pain, weight loss, fever, night sweats, fatigue, loss of appetite
preparation: No special preparation; provide early morning sputum specimen on 3 consecutive days if possible.
procedure: Prepare sputum smear, heat-fix, stain with carbolfuchsin, decolorize with acid alcohol, counterstain with methylene blue. Examine microscopically for acid-fast bacilli.
specimen: Sputum (preferred), may also use gastric aspirates or bronchoalveolar lavage

name: CULTURE AND SENSITIVITY / URINE
lo_ssx: Dysuria, frequency, urgency, suprapubic pain, flank pain, fever, chills
hi_ssx: Pyelonephritis: fever, chills, flank pain, nausea/vomiting; UTI: dysuria, frequency, urgency
preparation: Midstream clean-catch urine sample preferred. If catheterized, use sterile technique.

name: CULTURE AND SENSITIVITY / BODY FLUID
hi_ssx: N/A

name: RANDOM BLOOD SUGAR
lo_ssx: Hypoglycemia: sweating, shakiness, dizziness, confusion, blurred vision, irritability, seizures (severe).
hi_ssx: Hyperglycemia: frequent urination, increased thirst, fatigue, headache, blurred vision; in severe cases, nausea and altered consciousness.
preparation: Use finger stick on side of finger not on tip to minimize pain and tissue juice. Don't smear blood on strip; allow drop to dry on strip.

name: FASTING BLOOD SUGAR
lo_ssx: Hypoglycemia: hunger, sweating, tremors, confusion, irritability, blurred vision, seizures (severe).
hi_ssx: Hyperglycemia: excessive thirst, frequent urination, fatigue, nausea, headache, fruity breath odor (severe).
preparation: 8–10 hours fasting, no food or drinks except water before collection.

name: Dengue DUO (Ag/Ab) Screening
lo_ssx: May indicate early stage (<24h) or absence of dengue infection
hi_ssx: Fever >24 hours, headache, retro-orbital pain, myalgia, arthralgia, rash, bleeding manifestations
preference: For screening purposes only, not confirmatory. Interpretation: NS1 positive = possible acute dengue within 1–7 days of illness; IgM positive = recent/ongoing infection; IgG positive = past infection or secondary dengue.

name: Dengue Antibody Screening (IgG/IgM)
lo_ssx: Asymptomatic or mild fever, body weakness
hi_ssx: Fever >24 hours, headache, retro-orbital pain, myalgia, arthralgia, rash, bleeding manifestations
preparation: At least 24 hours of fever before testing
preference: For screening purposes only, not confirmatory. Interpretation: IgM positive = recent/ongoing infection; IgG positive = past infection or secondary dengue.

name: Dengue Antigen Screening (NS1)
hi_ssx: Fever >24 hours, headache, retro-orbital pain, myalgia, arthralgia, rash, bleeding manifestations
preparation: At least 24 hours of fever before testing
preference: For screening purposes only, not confirmatory. Interpretation: NS1 positive = possible acute dengue within 1–7 days of illness.

preparation: Avoid douching, intercourse, or vaginal medications 48 hours before test
description: A procedure in which a small brush is used to gently remove cells from the surface of the cervix and the area around it so they can be checked under a microscope for cervical cancer or cell changes that may lead to cervical cancer.
